title: Word Frequency
description:
Given `sentence = "the cat sat on the mat"`, count the frequency of each word and print them in alphabetical order, one per line in the format `word:count`.

**Expected output:**
```
cat:1
mat:1
on:1
sat:1
the:2
```
starterCode:
sentence = "the cat sat on the mat"
freq = {}
# Count word frequencies
# Print in alphabetical order
hint: Split the sentence, then for each word: freq[word] = freq.get(word, 0) + 1. Then loop over sorted(freq.keys()) to print.
